CustomObject.description: Durable queue for writing a newly created Salesforce id BACK to the HubSpot record it came from. The id only exists after the insert, and a callout after uncommitted DML throws, so the write-back must happen in a later transaction. It is staged here rather than in a Queueable because losing the (HubSpot id -> Salesforce id) pairing would leave a HubSpot record with a blank sf-id property that the next poll imports AGAIN as a duplicate Salesforce record -- the worst failure mode in the inbound design. Same role, and same drain-and-delete shape, as HS_Sync_Tombstone__c.
CustomObject.label: HS Inbound Stamp
